%22Aptitude_not_Attitude%22.name: Inscription

acquisition_tree.name: Inscriptions can be salvaged from any weapons that carry them by using a Perfect , expert , or superior salvage kit . (Expert and Superior kits have a chance of breaking the weapon when salvaging; see Salvage for details.) Weapons carrying inscription slots can be obtained in the following ways:
Nightfall and Eye of the North

children.name: Any drop of item rarity blue, purple or gold has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non- unique item that drops from the Urgoz 's elite chest or Kanaxai 's elite chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any weapon that drops from the Chest of Woe or Underworld Chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non-unique item that drops from the Hall of Heroes elite chest has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Some inscriptions cannot be unlocked at Priests of Balthazar unless your account includes Nightfall. (See specific notes in the tables below.)

%22Aptitude_not_Attitude%22.description: An inscription is a salvageable upgrade component that can be applied to equippable primary or off-hand weapons with an inscription slot.

Nightfall and Eye of the North

children.name: Any drop of item rarity blue, purple or gold has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non- unique item that drops from the Urgoz 's elite chest or Kanaxai 's elite chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any weapon that drops from the Chest of Woe or Underworld Chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non-unique item that drops from the Hall of Heroes elite chest has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.

Aptitude_not_Attitude.name: Inscription

acquisition_tree.name: Inscriptions can be salvaged from any weapons that carry them by using a Perfect , expert , or superior salvage kit . (Expert and Superior kits have a chance of breaking the weapon when salvaging; see Salvage for details.) Weapons carrying inscription slots can be obtained in the following ways:
Nightfall and Eye of the North

children.name: Any drop of item rarity blue, purple or gold has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non- unique item that drops from the Urgoz 's elite chest or Kanaxai 's elite chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any weapon that drops from the Chest of Woe or Underworld Chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non-unique item that drops from the Hall of Heroes elite chest has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Some inscriptions cannot be unlocked at Priests of Balthazar unless your account includes Nightfall. (See specific notes in the tables below.)

Aptitude_not_Attitude.description: An inscription is a salvageable upgrade component that can be applied to equippable primary or off-hand weapons with an inscription slot.

Baked_Husk.name: Baked Husk

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

There's only one place in pre-Searing where one can find Baked Husks, and that is the northern field at the exit of Ashford Abbey which is infested with Plague Worms. You can kill some of the bandits and wolves first if you want to reduce loot scaling . Worms spend more time buried underground (they cannot be killed then) than on the surface, so you'll have to wait until they pop up. A damaged worm will however not bury or if it was planning to, it will pop up as soon as possible. Minions should be able to attack worms if they are underground, Deathly Swarm can damage several worms in one hit and the fire imp can also kill some worms for you.

Baked_Husk.description: Baked Husks are the shells of the Plague Worms that infest the fields of Ascalon. The husks are used as fertilizers.

Berserker_Horn.name: Berserker Horn

children.name: Bjora Marches , Jaga Moraine , Varajar Fells

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and expert salvage research is ongoing and can be found here .
Farming Berserker Horns in Bjora Marches

Enter Bjora Marches from Longeye's Ledge . Following the route in the screenshot will take you from one group of minotaurs to the next. You can evade all other creatures, because there are barely any at all. There are on average 9 groups on the route. Groups consist of either 3 Berserking Bisons , 2 Berserking Wendigos and 2 Berserking Minotaurs or 2 Berserking Wendigos and 1 Berserking Aurochs . The last group can pose a problem for some standard farming builds because of the strong healing from the Berserking Aurochs. Try to either spike it down first or disrupt its spellcasting if you are having trouble killing this group. Use Heart of the Norn for extra health. The average run yields about 7-8 Berserker Horns.

Berserker_Horn.description: Berserker Horns are large horns from Minotaurs in the Far Shiverpeaks. Due to their size, some Norn use the horns on their helms.

Black_Moa_Chick.name: Black Moa Chick

acquisition_tree.name: This miniature can only be obtained after completing a cross-campaign scavenger hunt; the character must have access to all campaigns , including the Eye of the North expansion . In brief, you must:

Get a copy of Zho's Journal (requires EotN) ; Bring it to Katharine to craft an Incubator Kit (requires Factions) ; Fill the kit with 6 items from across the 3 continents (requires the three primary campaigns) ; Take the filled kit to Sorrow's Furnace and allow yourself to be zapped by the Iron Forgeman (requires Prophecies) .
Zho's Journal: provided by Zho in the third round of the Norn Fighting Tournament ; customized to each character.
Incubator Kit: crafted by Katharine in Gyala Hatchery (explorable area) for 50 , 10 , and 5 .

children.name: The character's personalized copy of Zho's Journal must be in their inventory when they speak to Katharine.
Reaching Katharine requires partial completion of the Luxon storyline.

acquisition_tree.name: Items for the kit: A Hardened Moa Egg , which requires taking a normal Moa Egg and hardening it. Moa Eggs can be found in one of the Moa Nests south of Fort Ranik in Regent Valley Eggs can be hardened at Mourning Veil Falls , a landmark southwest of Durheim Archives , which can be reached after partial completion of the Kurzick storyline. Nesting Material , from Nuwisha in southern Resplendent Makuun for 5 Skree Wings . A Volcanic Rock , from north-eastern Perdition Rock . A Herring , from Gruhn the Fisher (in western Twin Serpent Lakes ), in exchange for 5 Bog Skale Fins (which can be farmed in Tears of the Fallen or Stingray Strand ). A Branch of Juni Berries , a reward from the Insatiable Appetite quest in Marga Coast . A Honeycomb , which is most easily obtained as a random drop from a Gift of the Traveler , Gift of the Huntsman , from PvE foes during Anniversary Celebrations , or completing A Hunter's Pride . (There are two other sources .)

To place the items in the incubator, double-click on the incubator to open a small window and drag the item into it. Doing this will remove the item from your inventory.  The incubator window will show translucent icons as place holders for the six items, which will be replaced with the opaque icon when each item is added.

Once all six items are placed in the incubator, travel to Sorrow's Furnace with the quest The Final Assault and The Forge Heart active. Fight your way to the central furnace and allow yourself to be hit by Sorrow's Flame , which will hatch the Black Moa Chick (consuming the incubator and its contents). If you are having trouble hatching the chick: check that you were actually hit by Sorrow's Flame and that all items are inside the incubator (and not just in your inventory).
Although the nearby giant furnace (near the Rage Binders ) uses a similar skill, the Black Moa Chick hatches only if you are covered by the liquid metal poured down by the Iron Forgeman.

Black_Moa_Chick.description: The Black Moa Chick is a green miniature.

acquisition_tree.name: Starting from Jennur's Horde , head north through the Vehjin Mines to the Holdings of Chokhin portal . Once through, head north to kill the 14 giants. Using a Spoil Victor 55hp build (and focusing solely on the giants), the run takes 10 minutes including rezoning at the Vehjin Mines portal. A Vow of Silence build with Shroud of Distress using apple, cupcake, and pie can do a run in 7 minutes.

Start from either Basalt Grotto or Jennur's Horde. Head towards the blue circles on the farming map, which mark the locations of groups of giants that each spawn together with 2-4 Hunting Minotaurs . Celestial_Essence.name: Celestial Essence

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and expert salvage research is ongoing and can be found here .
Farming Celestial Essences in Nahpui Quarter

In order for them to spawn , you must first eliminate their respective bosses. Killing Kaijun Don , the Kirin celestial, will cause Essences of Kirin to spawn, and so on. Bear in mind that, after a short period of time, essences will respawn upon returning to their original locations. These, in turn, will not drop loot, which makes backtracking less attractive for farming.

Proceed with the mission as normal, leaving the last boss alive to prevent completion. It is recommended to start with the left-most portal and leaving Hai Jii alive as Essences of Phoenix will consistently interrupt your skills. When fighting Kuonghsang or Essence of Turtle , consider moving out of aggro range to prevent being the target of Grenth's Balance once they are low on health. Consider also venturing outside the path shown to eliminate additional groups of Celestials.

One method is to bring a solo farming build and a party of henchmen and/or heroes . Have them help kill all the Tengu , but avoid killing any of the bosses. Once the map is cleared of Tengu, flag your party away and solo farm the Celestials. Essences of Phoenix can be solo farmed by a spirit spammer , since they rely on hex spells to deal damage and spirits cannot be hexed. Essences of Dragon and Essences of Turtle can be solo farmed using spell targeting prevention skills, since they only use spells .

Cerulean_Edge.name: Cerulean Edge
Cerulean_Edge.description: This sword shares a similar shape with the Violet Edge and Emerald Edge. Three things distinguish these oddly shaped swords from one another; the first and most noticeable is the color. The Violet Edge is purple in color, the Emerald Edge is green, and the Cerulean Edge is a light blue. Secondly, the small golden orb located above the grip in the first curve of the blade is held in place by braces; on the Violet Edge, one brace holds it in place, on the Emerald, two settings hold it, and on the Cerulean Edge, three braces securely fasten it. Lastly, the three Edges differ slightly in size, with the Violet being the smallest, the Emerald being slightly longer, and the Cerulean being the largest.

Charr_Hide.name: Charr Hide

acquisition_tree.name: Contents 1 Acquisition 1.1 Farming 2 Collectors 2.1 Calissa Sedgwick 2.2 Nicholas the Traveler 3 Notes
Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

This mission contains only Charr foes . Simply run through the mission in normal mode until you reach the area with Siegemaster Lormar and the trebuchets, killing all the Charr along the way. Instead of helping Lormar and using the trebuchets, simply attack the massive groups of Charr gathered where the trebuchet shots would land. A solo player with appropriate survival skills can easily gather a full set of five hides and more over the course of a single run of the mission. Blocking skills are especially helpful since most of the Charr's damage will come from physical attacks .

You can pull the lever at the start of the mission to allow the Charr in. Multiple groups of melee Charr can be farmed here in normal mode very easily using blocking skills or AoE blindness. There are some builds that can gather up all the Charr in the area (boss included) even in hard mode, mainly casters with heavy damage mitigation and anti-knockdown skills.

Charr_Hide.description: Charr Hides are salvage items that drop from all Charr in Ascalon, both before and after The Searing.

Chunks_of_Drake_Flesh.name: Chunk of Drake Flesh

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and expert salvage research is ongoing and can be found here .
Farming Drake Flesh in Mehtani Keys .

Start from Kodlonu Hamlet and hunt Irontooth Drakes in the 4 marked spots. You can usually avoid fighting other foes if you're careful. Near the second spot you'll find 2 groups of Corsairs ; the eastern group will patrol far enough for you to slip by in most cases. At the last spot marked on the map, a group of Mandragors lies ready to pop up nearby so fight close to the shrine to avoid unwanted aggro. There are also two more groups of Drakes to the north of the last marked spot, beyond a few groups of Corsairs that can't be avoided (near Ajamduk, Hunter of the Sands ), but for farming purposes these are less efficient to include.
Farming Drake Flesh in Plains of Jarin .
There are two Irontooth Drakes just east outside of Champion's Dawn (do not use AoE skills so you can avoid aggroing the nearby Juvenile Bladed Termites ). Another two are outside the Astralarium .
Farming Drake Flesh during Rilohn Refuge (mission) and in The Floodplain of Mahnkelon .

There are two groups of four Steelfang Drakes near the beginning of the mission. (Be careful not to trigger Dehjah ; if she dies too soon, you will be kicked from the mission and might miss collecting your loot .)

There are about six drakes outside the Moddok Crevice door (in the water, just past the shrine). If you have Drakes on the Plain active, there will be two more groups just north east of the entrance to Rilohn Refuge.

Chunks_of_Drake_Flesh.description: A piece of drake meat with skin still attached to it.

Start from Kodlonu Hamlet and hunt Irontooth Drakes in the 4 marked spots. You can usually avoid fighting other foes if you're careful. Near the second spot you'll find 2 groups of Corsairs ; the eastern group will patrol far enough for you to slip by in most cases. At the last spot marked on the map, a group of Mandragors lies ready to pop up nearby so fight close to the shrine to avoid unwanted aggro. There are also two more groups of Drakes to the north of the last marked spot, beyond a few groups of Corsairs that can't be avoided (near Ajamduk, Hunter of the Sands ), but for farming purposes these are less efficient to include.
Farming Drake Flesh in Plains of Jarin .
There are two Irontooth Drakes just east outside of Champion's Dawn (do not use AoE skills so you can avoid aggroing the nearby Juvenile Bladed Termites ). Another two are outside the Astralarium .
Farming Drake Flesh during Rilohn Refuge (mission) and in The Floodplain of Mahnkelon .

There are two groups of four Steelfang Drakes near the beginning of the mission. (Be careful not to trigger Dehjah ; if she dies too soon, you will be kicked from the mission and might miss collecting your loot .)

There are about six drakes outside the Moddok Crevice door (in the water, just past the shrine). If you have Drakes on the Plain active, there will be two more groups just north east of the entrance to Rilohn Refuge.

Copper_Crimson_Skull_Coin.name: Copper Crimson Skull Coin

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Start from Tsumei Village , following the route on the map, you will encounter no foes other than Crimson Skull. When focusing on getting just Copper Crimson Skull Coins, it might be wise to avoid some of the high level Crimson Skull marked on the map by Gold and Silver coins, though not all of them can be evaded easily. Average drops are around 3 Copper, 1.5 Silver and 0.5 Gold coins when not evading enemies (resulting in one gold coin for every two runs).

Another option is to use the quest The Siege at Tsumei Village to have a large spawn of Crimson Skull right outside either side of Tsumei Village. This can be combined with the farm above though the quest does diminish the amount of Crimson Skull spawning in the other areas somewhat.

This run isn't advised when farming just for Copper Crimson Skull Coins, as the other run is easier and yields more Copper Coins. Starting from Zen Daijun , follow the route up to the Crimson Skull camp near the sea, you can evade all foes except for some Crimson Skull on the route. Having The Captured Son active will vastly improve spawns of all levels of Crimson Skulls at the camp though it makes farming a bit more difficult. Without the quest active, runs yield an average of 1 Copper Crimson Skull Coin.

Copper_Crimson_Skull_Coin.description: Copper Crimson Skull Coins are dropped by low-level Crimson Skull on Shing Jea Island.

Enter from Beknur Harbor and walk towards the quarry (see map). You will encounter 5 patrols of 2-3 Corsair before the quarry and three large groups patrolling small areas inside. The three ledges out of the quarry each have a patrol of 2 Corsair as well. Clear everything, then re-enter from Beknur Harbor to repeat. A run averages about 4 Copper Shillings.

Dessicated_Hydra_Claw.name: Dessicated Hydra Claw

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and expert salvage research is ongoing and can be found here .

Hydra have a particularly strong presence in Skyward Reach . As per their nature, abilities that prevent knock downs and provide fire or elemental damage resistance are particularly useful against them.

Start from Augury Rock and head eastwards along the northern path until you reach the teleporter . Activate it and continue clearing the area in a clockwise fashion, eventually making your way back to Augury Rock.
You will encounter mostly Hydras, commonly in groups of two to three, with the occasional group of four. Some groups may patrol outside the path shown, but can still be found within compass range.
A full solo run will normally yield 4-8 Dessicated Hydra Claws.

Dessicated_Hydra_Claw.description: Dessicated Hydra Claws are trophies dropped by Hydra in the Crystal Desert.

Don't_Fear_the_Reaper.name: Inscription

acquisition_tree.name: Inscriptions can be salvaged from any weapons that carry them by using a Perfect , expert , or superior salvage kit . (Expert and Superior kits have a chance of breaking the weapon when salvaging; see Salvage for details.) Weapons carrying inscription slots can be obtained in the following ways:
Nightfall and Eye of the North

children.name: Any drop of item rarity blue, purple or gold has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non- unique item that drops from the Urgoz 's elite chest or Kanaxai 's elite chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any weapon that drops from the Chest of Woe or Underworld Chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non-unique item that drops from the Hall of Heroes elite chest has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Some inscriptions cannot be unlocked at Priests of Balthazar unless your account includes Nightfall. (See specific notes in the tables below.)

Don't_Fear_the_Reaper.description: An inscription is a salvageable upgrade component that can be applied to equippable primary or off-hand weapons with an inscription slot.

Dragon_Root.name: Dragon Root

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .
Warning: This key section of the article is incomplete. You can help the Guild Wars Wiki by expanding it .

The quest A New Escort triggers the spawns of three groups of 4 Dragon Mosses near Saint Anjeka's Shrine . Using a spell prevention skill, aggro those foes then immediately backtrack to avoid also aggroing the nearby Wardens . Those Dragon Mosses inflict lightning damage from range and can be easily killed with skills such as Sliver Armor or Whirling Defense combined with Ebon Battle Standard of Honor . Storm Chaser and Mantra of Lightning are good to resplenish energy.

Start from the south exit of Maatu Keep , stay close to the westen limit of the paths to Tanglewood Copse .  Look around the rocks near the entrance of Tanglewood Copse .  There are Undergrowths and Dragon Mosses all along the route to Tanglewood Copse .

Dragon_Root.description: Dragon Roots are roots belonging to the dragon-like plants of the Echovald Forest, and dropped as trophies. They are used by Kurzick healers in a pain reliever for victims of the plague.

DTT.name: Inscription

acquisition_tree.name: Inscriptions can be salvaged from any weapons that carry them by using a Perfect , expert , or superior salvage kit . (Expert and Superior kits have a chance of breaking the weapon when salvaging; see Salvage for details.) Weapons carrying inscription slots can be obtained in the following ways:
Nightfall and Eye of the North

children.name: Any drop of item rarity blue, purple or gold has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non- unique item that drops from the Urgoz 's elite chest or Kanaxai 's elite chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any weapon that drops from the Chest of Woe or Underworld Chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non-unique item that drops from the Hall of Heroes elite chest has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Some inscriptions cannot be unlocked at Priests of Balthazar unless your account includes Nightfall. (See specific notes in the tables below.)

DTT.description: An inscription is a salvageable upgrade component that can be applied to equippable primary or off-hand weapons with an inscription slot.

Dull_Carapace.name: Dull Carapace

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

The run takes ~4min and has 17 devourers (and at least one more during The Poison Devourer ). Some lvl 0 skales can be killed to avoid loot scaling. Leave Ascalon City and head south. The Devourer Cave is full of Devourers and is also near the entrance to Regent Valley , allowing to extend the farm with the following route :

The run lasts ~5min and has 24 devourers but no way to reduce loot scaling. There are many devourers close to where Master Ranger Nente stands (Nente is hostile to them) and along the way to the statue of Melandru (the landmark known as King's Watch ). A couple of devourers are close to the river.

There are several devourers in the southern part of the Catacombs. Use the exit to Wizard's Folly to rezone. The run lasts ~7mins and has 20-25 devourers, most of them being lvl 0 Diseased Devourers and therefore very easy to kill.

Dull_Carapace.description: A Dull Carapace is a trophy dropped by Devourers in pre-Searing Ascalon.

Dune_Burrower_Jaw.name: Dune Burrower Jaw

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and expert salvage research is ongoing and can be found here .

Dune Burrowers can be found in the beginning of the mission. Upon entering, kill the Minotaurs first so that the drop rate for Dune Burrower Jaws becomes higher, and then kill the 9 Dune Burrowers there. The Splinter Mines are effective to take out large groups of Minotaurs, and the bleeding effect is useful against the Dune Burrowers as well.

Dune_Burrower_Jaw.description: Dune Burrower Jaws are the jaws of Behemoths from the Crystal Desert.

Enchanted_Lodestone.name: Enchanted Lodestone

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Leave from Barradin's Estate . Head north, then west toward the cave. Once you've cleared the area, backtrack toward the Barradin's Estate but go south now to kill a couple more stone elementals. Then go straight east and clear the entire area. The total run takes around 15min with a total of ~60 stone elementals.

Follow the farming route for Icy Lodestones ; aside from several ones around Wizard's Tower and along the northern road, the area past the ice cave has a lot of Stone Elementals (and a dozen Large Aloe Seeds if the quest Unnatural Growths is not yet completed).

Enchanted_Lodestone.description: Enchanted Lodestones are pieces of Elementals of Ascalon before the Searing. They were known to have a "subtle glow" in darkness. However, after the Searing, the Elementals and their lodestones became scorched like the land.

acquisition_tree.name: If your character hasn't completed the quest Revenge of the Yeti it can be a great source for farming. Make your way from Tsumei Village north to Wulk Cragfist killing the three Sensali on the way. Fight him and the Sensali nearby, then grab the quest. Head to the quest marker and kill the 7 Sensali there. They can be a bit tough since there's a lot of them, especially for a low level character or a solo-farm. Bring AoE since they tend to clump, and Spirits or Minions can help shield the player. You can wait for Cragfist to walk over and use him to pull aggro and tank as well, it won't matter if he dies since you don't intend to complete the quest anyway. Pick up the drops then map back to Tsumei Village. Don't forget to abandon the quest before heading out again. In around 3 mins you fight 11 Sensali, and net around 2-3 Feathered Scalps.
Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Feathered_Scalp.description: These Feathered Scalps were once a part of Sensali Tengu. They are used as proof that one killed Sensali for both Canthans and Angchu Tengu.

3 groups of 3 Drakes each can be found just past the first Mursaat Tower. Be wary that one of the groups patrol into the volcano just northeast of the spot, and that entering that volcano will cause an Ettin group with a boss to move south through it.

6 Nightmares can also be found in that same section of the missions, 2 just west of the mission starting point and another 4 near the drakes, making this a good spot to farm both Fiery Crests and Smoking Remains .

Forest_Minotaur_Horn.name: Forest Minotaur Horn

children.name: The Black Curtain , Kessex Peak , Talmark Wilderness

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Head south from Temple of the Ages towards the portal to Kessex Peak . The area around the portal contains about 12-18 Forest Minotaurs with another 6-10 east of the portal. Use the portal to rezone . If War in Kryta is active, most of the Forest Minotaur spawns will be replaced with Peacekeepers that also kill any Forest Minotaurs they aggro .

There are a lot of Forest Minotaurs around Dakutu Village / Shining Blade camp . Use Artisan Sivan (and/or William Stafford if War in Kryta is active) to sell drops . Use Tears of the Fallen to rezone. See the map for general routes, Minotaur spawns are marked. The route consists mostly of Forest Minotaurs except for 2 Ancient Oakhearts which you can evade if you want to and the occasional pop-up of a single Fog Nightmare . Occasionally the boss Muu Swifthorn spawns at the marker. Besides the groups marked on your map, there are 2 patrols of 2 Forest Minotaurs walking clockwise around both hills. An average run yields about 8 horns.

Forest_Minotaur_Horn.description: Forest Minotaur Horns are the horns of Forest Minotaurs.

Frigid_Heart.name: Frigid Heart

children.name: Far Shiverpeaks and Depths of Tyria

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and expert salvage research is ongoing and can be found here .
Farming Ice Imps in Ice Floe

Ice Imps are notable for their use of Water Magic, specifically Maelstrom and Mind Freeze . Consider spreading out your party to avoid being consistently interrupted . General anti-caster , hex removal , and/or spell targeting prevention skills are effective against them.
Farming Ice Imps in Talus Chute

Start from Marhan's Grotto and follow the eastern path along the coast and you will find exclusively Ice Imps up until the end of the route indicated in the wiki map. Commonly, groups will consist of three to four Ice Imps, with one particularly sizable group that can be found about halfway through. On average, a full run of the route indicated will net you 4-12 Frigid Hearts.

Start from Ice Caves of Sorrow and follow the path down the mountain, turning left as you cross the bridge. The groups of Ice Imps here are greater in size, and may be difficult to farm on your own. Following this route, you can expect to receive 2-6 Frigid Hearts on average.

Frigid_Heart.description: Frigid Hearts are cores of stone and coal within the chests of the Ice Imps that populate the Shiverpeak Mountains. Even after the Imp is slain, the heart can remain cold for weeks, regardless of how warm the environment.

Frigid_Mandragor_Husk.name: Frigid Mandragor Husk

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Enter from Eye of the North and follow the route on the map. You will encounter 5 groups of Mandragor and can evade all other enemies. Mandragor patrol small areas but are quite fast, the easiest way to fight them is to lure them to you by attacking one of the Spirit of Toxicity that they place along their paths, which will save you time running after them and won't bring you in contact with the traps they place. Condition removal might be useful for this farm.

You can run this route solo with a Signet of Spirits build. Recommended inclusions are Disenchantment for Dreamroots, Shadowsong to keep the Mystics blinded , and Mend Body and Soul for condition removal.

Gargoyle_Skull.name: Gargoyle Skull

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Enter the Catacombs from Ashford Abbey. There's a hidden path behind where Munne stands, follow this path to find an area heavily populated with Gargoyles . Follow the path to the west (you'll encounter more gargoyles along the way). At one point the road splits to the west and to the east. East is a great hall with 5 gargoyles down the stairs and 3 more a bit further away. West is a big bridge over some kind of dragon skeleton and leading to the exit to Green Hills County with around 9 gargoyles. Shatter Gargoyles (4 in total, in remote locations) possess Backfire , which can deal around 50 damage to your character each time you cast a spell. Refrain from using spells when hexed if you're low on health. Alternatively, use a martial weapon (not a wand or staff) since the AI only cast it on characters using a caster weapon.

Gargoyle_Skull.description: Gargoyle Skulls are the skulls found on Gargoyles from before the Searing.

Geode.name: Geode

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Exit southeast from Mihanu Township . Go a short distance along the north wall to a group of five beetles. From here go southeast - sticking close to the scarp  to avoid any other creatures - to another group of five beetles. Continue south and find two more groups, weaving between patrols to avoid aggro . The run ends at the Kodash Bazaar , allowing you to zone back into the Mirror of Lyss to repeat the route in reverse. The drop rate seems to average 1 Geode per beetle group every 3 minutes (or total of 4-5 per run). The run takes 12-15 minutes.

Geode.description: Geodes are shining rocks that are hoarded by the beetles in Vabbi.

Glowing_Heart.name: Glowing Heart

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and expert salvage research is ongoing and can be found here .
Farming Glowing Hearts in North Kryta Province

Start from either D'Alessio Seaboard or Lion's Arch . There are several groups of either 2 or 3 Imps roughly at the crossmarks on the map but they tend to move around a bit. You can avoid most other enemies although there is often a single Bog Skale spawning with the group closest to the Lion's Arch exit and a group of 3 Caromi that only spawns occasionally near the bridge. The run can be started from either portal, finishing close to the other portal. It may thus be more time efficient to walk into the portal and back out if you need to do another run, instead of Mapping .
An average run yields 1 or 2 Glowing Hearts.
Farming Glowing Hearts in Stingray Strand

Start from Sanctum Cay and proceed north by hugging the left wall until you reach the vast empty grass area prior to the groups of Caromi. There are several groups of Inferno Imps and only an initial group of Lightning Drakes .

Glowing_Heart.description: Glowing Hearts are trophy items dropped by low-level imps in Kryta. Glowing Hearts are often used by people to create small fires by striking two together.

Gold_Crimson_Skull_Coin.name: Gold Crimson Skull Coin

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Starting from Zen Daijun , follow the route up to the Crimson Skull camp near the sea, you can evade all foes except for some Crimson Skull on the route. At the camp, four high level Crimson Skull reside (at the location of the player marker on the map) together with Miki the Skull Spirit who doesn't drop Gold Crimson Skull Coins. This run will also return some Silver Crimson Skull Coins and Copper Crimson Skull Coins . Having The Captured Son active will vastly improve spawns of all levels of Crimson Skulls though it makes farming a bit more difficult.

This run isn't advised when farming for Gold Crimson Skull Coins alone, as the other run is faster. Start from Tsumei Village , following the route on the map, you will encounter no foes other than Crimson Skull. There are three bosses on the route with a chance of dropping two Silver Crimson Skull Coins at once (marked on the map), four high level Crimson Skull with a chance of dropping Gold Crimson Skull Coins (also marked on the map) and a lot of low level mobs dropping Copper Crimson Skull Coins, including some pop-ups. Average drops are around 6 Copper, 2 Silver and 0.5 Gold coins per run (resulting in one gold coin for every two runs).

Gold_Crimson_Skull_Coin.description: Gold Crimson Skull Coins are dropped by high-level Crimson Skull on Shing Jea Island.

Warning: This key section of the article is incomplete. You can help the Guild Wars Wiki by expanding it .
Leave Fort Ranik and head to the south-west corner of the area riddled with skales. You should find a path leading up a hill. Follow the way until you reach The Bear Hunters .

Right after them, to the west, you'll find a plain heavily populated with Grawl and Grawl Shamans . The area extends to the Healing Spring . You can rezone south at the portal to Wizard's Folly for a second run.
Alternatively, the start of this run coincides nicely with the end of the Spider Leg run , allowing you to chain both runs.

More Grawl can be found beyond the Healing Spring. A few can be found on the hill behind the statue of Melandru to the north, and to the west then north along the banks of the river. This may however slow down the farm.

Leave Ascalon City and head straight to the west, or Ashford Abbey and head straight to the north. There are around 8 Grawls in the area close to where the bull usually stands. You can also kill some Plague Worms for Baked Husks there.
This run can be followed by the next one.

There are numerous Grawl in the large North Eastern field of Green Hills County.  Leave the Barradin Estate and travel counter clockwise to get to the edge of the field, then work your way north then east.
You can zone at the exit to Lakeside County, then reenter Green Hills County and retrace your steps for a second run.
The field has numerous Aloe Seeds , so it is also a good spot for Unnatural Seeds and to get around loot scaling .
This run combines nicely with the end of the Enchanted Lodestone run , going further east instead of north.

Grawl_Necklace.description: The Grawl Necklace can be found as a drop from Grawl in pre-Searing Ascalon.

Gruesome_Ribcage.name: Gruesome Ribcage

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Enter Dragon's Gullet from Flame Temple Corridor and follow the route on the map, the direction you take when clearing the circle part doesn't matter as you'll have to circle back to rezone after the farm regardless of which way you walk it. This route mostly contains groups of between 2-4 Abomination though groups may occasionally spawn together and be hard to pull apart. One group of Hydra , a couple groups of Tar Behemoth and very occasionally a group of Charr are also along the route though these should not be too hard to take down. Bringing a bow to pull groups spawning inside the tar can help speed up the farm.

The exact spawn locations and numbers of Abomination fluctuate quite a bit, hence the blue paths on the map. There won't be any spawns outside of these routes though. Sometimes Morl Grell spawns on the marked location. After clearing the route, walk back to the portal to rezone. An average run yields about 6-7 ribcages.

acquisition_tree.name: Inscriptions can be salvaged from any weapons that carry them by using a Perfect , expert , or superior salvage kit . Nightfall and Eye of the North

children.name: Any drop of item rarity blue, purple or gold has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non- unique item that drops from the Urgoz 's elite chest or Kanaxai 's elite chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any weapon that drops from the Chest of Woe or Underworld Chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.

Hardened_Hump.name: Hardened Hump

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Solo players can start from Bergen Hot Springs . Avoid the first Skeleton group. There will be a fight between Tengus and Gypsie Ettins ahead. Once the Ettins win, they will head through the corridor towards the outpost and ball around you. Continue west (walking in front of Nicholas) by the skales and proceed north towards Nebo Village passing close to the Statue of Dwayna . Finally head west through the narrow corridor to Beetletun where there will be several Ettins. They usually group in 2-3. Stop when you see more Caromis .

If you have War in Kryta content active, this farm will be less easy. First of all, if Courier Falken spawns when you exit Bergen Hot Springs immediately zone as he will spawn additional groups of White Mantle along the route and run into them making the farm much harder. Furthermore, certain other spawns related to War in Kryta content, like the spawning of High Inquisitor Toriimo with a group of Krytan Villagers will replace all of the early Gypsie Ettin spawns. If these spawns do not take place, you can do the farm.  Follow the adviced route apart from these details: instead of going west where suggested, which will have you fight several groups of White Mantle that can be hard to solo, go upwards facing more groups of Tengu instead.

Hardened_Hump.description: Hardened Humps are trophy items dropped from Gypsie Ettin in Kryta. According to Nicholas the Traveler, Hardened Humps are capable of storing heat.

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

2 groups of heket - one just outside Pogahn Passage (outpost) , and the other a short distance away to the east. There are only melee classes in each group, so are a quick and easy farm, and should present few if any problems for solo farming builds.

There are 6 groups patrolling outside Camp Hojanu . These groups can sometimes include a Blue Tongue Heket healing the other heket, which can make defeating the group more difficult than farming Gandara above. Farming builds will either need to shutdown the healing, or overcome it with significant damage.  Less experienced players may find it helpful to have 2-3 players farm, in which one player acts as party-defense/healer-shutdown while the other 1-2 concentrate on dealing damage.

Hecket_tongue.description: Heket Tongues are long slimy tongues of a Heket; they are said to hold universal curative qualities. According to Kaya, they are an ingredient to turn people into toads.

Iboga_Petal.name: Iboga Petal

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .
Run by the edges of the explorable area. Start from Kamadan and finish halfway at The Astralarium . You can go either northwards or southwards.

(Nightfall character only method)
Use the quest Scholarly Affairs to spawn Beautiful Iboga . Upon entering Cliffs of Dohjok do not talk to Zerai and go kill the Beautiful Iboga along the northern edge of the map. They drop Iboga Blossoms which you do not need if you are farming petals so ignore them. They also drop Iboga Petals so as long as you do not complete the quest you can repeat the farm. It is a secondary quest and as such is not necessary to advance the Nightfall storyline.

Iboga_Petal.description: Iboga Petals are a type of trophy item that drops from various Iboga throughout Elona. They are the leafy remains of the sentient Iboga that wander the island of Istan. They have spicy taste and often cause immediate nausea. Despite this, these leaves are a key ingredient in Pahnai Salad, and so are prized by chefs. However, the obvious danger inherent in harvesting Iboga petals makes Pahnai Salad a rare treat at best. They are also often used in sandwiches.

Icy_Lodestone.name: Icy Lodestone

children.name: 7 to 12 can be received from a Sack of Random Junk given to the player by Lieutenant Thackeray during his scavenger hunt .

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Start from Yak's Bend and enter Traveler's Vale.  There are several ice elementals to the north and to the center of the map. However the following farming road is a lot faster provided you can mule the icy lodestones.

Leave Foible's Fair and follow the snowy road up the mountain in Wizard's Folly. There's a cave with 7~8 lvl3 ice elementals on the way to the south (don't go near Aziure). You can kill 3-4 more around the Wizard's tower (not advised, unless you like walking) or go on after the cave toward the west (advised, 4 more close to the cave). The advised run takes 5-8mins and has 20 of the ~24 ice elementals in total on the whole map, all in the snowy landscape. They are highly vulnerable to fire, so using fire magic spells or the fire imp is advised. The farming route is also a good way to farm experience in Pre-Searing at low levels and get Enchanted Lodestones .

Icy_Lodestone.description: Icy Lodestones are the frosty stone remnants of Elemental creatures composed of ice.

Inscription.1.name: Inscription

acquisition_tree.name: Inscriptions can be salvaged from any weapons that carry them by using a Perfect , expert , or superior salvage kit . (Expert and Superior kits have a chance of breaking the weapon when salvaging; see Salvage for details.) Weapons carrying inscription slots can be obtained in the following ways:
Nightfall and Eye of the North

children.name: Any drop of item rarity blue, purple or gold has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non- unique item that drops from the Urgoz 's elite chest or Kanaxai 's elite chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any weapon that drops from the Chest of Woe or Underworld Chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non-unique item that drops from the Hall of Heroes elite chest has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Some inscriptions cannot be unlocked at Priests of Balthazar unless your account includes Nightfall. (See specific notes in the tables below.)

Inscription.1.description: An inscription is a salvageable upgrade component that can be applied to equippable primary or off-hand weapons with an inscription slot.

Jungle_Troll_Tusk.name: Jungle Troll Tusk

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .
Farming tusks outside Henge of Denravi

Start from Henge of Denravi . At the beginning, you will encounter a pair of Life Pods and a couple of Moss Scarabs ; if you need to, outrun them or pull the two groups apart. The remaining mobs along the route are level 14 or 18 Jungle Trolls . There are two places (marked on the map by tusk icons) where three groups of trolls spawn close to each other; pull them apart if you need to. The full route (blue and red paths) yields around three tusks per run.

Start from Ettin's Back . Near the entrance to Reed Bog there is a small group of Jungle Trolls , and another large group slightly farther in to the south. A short run and re-zone can net around half a dozen drops.

Jungle_Troll_Tusk.description: A Jungle Troll Tusk is a collectable drop from Jungle Trolls.

Leaf_on_the_Wind.name: Inscription

acquisition_tree.name: Inscriptions can be salvaged from any weapons that carry them by using a Perfect , expert , or superior salvage kit . (Expert and Superior kits have a chance of breaking the weapon when salvaging; see Salvage for details.) Weapons carrying inscription slots can be obtained in the following ways:
Nightfall and Eye of the North

children.name: Any drop of item rarity blue, purple or gold has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non- unique item that drops from the Urgoz 's elite chest or Kanaxai 's elite chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any weapon that drops from the Chest of Woe or Underworld Chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non-unique item that drops from the Hall of Heroes elite chest has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Some inscriptions cannot be unlocked at Priests of Balthazar unless your account includes Nightfall. (See specific notes in the tables below.)

Leaf_on_the_Wind.description: An inscription is a salvageable upgrade component that can be applied to equippable primary or off-hand weapons with an inscription slot.

Leathery_Claw.name: Leathery Claw

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Enter from either Diessa Lowlands (from Grendich Courthouse or Nolani Academy ) or Traveler's Vale (from Yak's Bend ). If you enter from Diessa Lowlands, use the Traveler's Vale portal to rezone and vice-versa. You can sell drops to Artisan Rudger to clear inventory space.

Head east from Grendich Courthouse then northeast through the Flame Temple Corridor , arriving in Dragon's Gullet.  Head north from the entrance until you reach the tar pits, killing a few small Charr groups that are in your way.  You will be able to see several Hydra as you approach the shore of the tar pits.  Kill those and then head west around the edge of the tar pits to the northern section of the map and work your way east. There are many Hydra here.
Once you begin to encounter Abominations while you're working east along the northern section of the map, the Hydra are pretty much done.  Retrace your route back to the entrance to rezone.

Leathery_Claw.description: Leathery Claws are the claws of the Hydra native to the northern regions of post-Searing Ascalon, dropped as trophies

Luminous_Stone.name: Luminous Stone

acquisition_tree.name: Drop research is ongoing and can be found here .
Farming Luminous Stones in Arkjok Ward

Roughly cover the area following the route provided by the map. A lot of the Mandragor groups are partially or entirely made up of pop-ups. Be careful not to over aggro as you can run into additional pop-ups when manoeuvring or fleeing. At the start of the route you will encounter some groups of Insects that you can't evade. Be careful not to fight a group within compass range of another because the Veldt Beetle Queens will start healing for other groups, making them potentially difficult to take down.

You will encounter roughly 25 groups of between 3-5 Mandragors if you cover the entire route, netting you approximately 4-5 Luminous Stones and 3-4 Mandragor Roots . One of the groups contains Enadiz the Hardheaded but he shouldn't prove to be hard with any farm build that is capable of taking on the normal groups.
Click here to see route in Arkjok Ward.
Click here to see the alternative route in Barbarous Shore.

Luminous_Stone.description: Luminous Stones are dropped by Mandragors in Kourna and the Desolation.

Mahgo_Claw.name: Mahgo Claw

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .
There are two groups of Mahgo Hydra right in front of the Ember Light Camp outpost.

A Phantom (NPC) spawn is usually close to them, which can spam Blind on you. Avoid going into the Phantom's aggro range if its skills could be an issue. Phantoms are unlinked to Hydras, so chain-aggroing them is not an issue. Sometimes, Phantoms will spawn from the ground when you get into their range, which can force a reset of the run. It is possible to run away from them and break aggro, if there is enough space for running.
Flesh Golem spawns are also usually found near Hydras, but their aggro is unlinked to other mobs, making it easy to avoid pulling them, just like Phantoms.

Any farming build that can deal with Fire Magic spells should be able to solo farm the Hydras. Zoning in and out of the outpost to kill just the two groups in front of it is a valid strategy. The total amount of Hydras in these two groups may vary, and sometimes a third group may appear and walk towards the outpost entrance if the spawn is favorable.

Mahgo_Claw.description: Mahgo Claws are trophies, a type of item that can be exchanged with collectors for other items.

Massive_Jawbone.name: Massive Jawbone

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Start from Destiny's Gorge , head towards the resurrection shrine and turn right, you shall see the suspension bridge (green dots on the linked map) to the East, cross underneath. During this path, depending on spawns you shall face a Sand Wurm and 2-3 groups of Scarab pop-ups which you can ignore while proceeding to the eastern border of the map. Sand Giants locations may vary but are always on the plateau or the shallow valley. There are two ramps to access the high ground (blue dots). When the plateau ends, return and locate the Dune Burrower which stands next to the ramp towards the valley and you shall find a crossroads. There is a short walk to the west which ends on the edge. The last Sand Giants will be patrolling up to a second Dune Burrower. Sand Giants patrol in groups of 2 or 3, and use Giant Stomp once they stop at touch range, count heads to calculate knock-downs. Click here to see the Farming route.

Start from Dunes of Despair (outpost) and use the teleporter immediately to the east.  Continue southeast towards the lower portal to The Arid Sea running past one or two Sand Wurms that will emerge along this path.  There will be two groups of Sand Giants near the portal.  Continue north through the canyon and bear to the left at the first opportunity to find a few more groups.  This run typically has around a dozen giants and takes only a few minutes.

Miniature_Black_Moa_Chick.name: Black Moa Chick

acquisition_tree.name: This miniature can only be obtained after completing a cross-campaign scavenger hunt; the character must have access to all campaigns , including the Eye of the North expansion . In brief, you must:

Get a copy of Zho's Journal (requires EotN) ; Bring it to Katharine to craft an Incubator Kit (requires Factions) ; Fill the kit with 6 items from across the 3 continents (requires the three primary campaigns) ; Take the filled kit to Sorrow's Furnace and allow yourself to be zapped by the Iron Forgeman (requires Prophecies) .
Zho's Journal: provided by Zho in the third round of the Norn Fighting Tournament ; customized to each character.
Incubator Kit: crafted by Katharine in Gyala Hatchery (explorable area) for 50 , 10 , and 5 .

children.name: The character's personalized copy of Zho's Journal must be in their inventory when they speak to Katharine.
Reaching Katharine requires partial completion of the Luxon storyline.

acquisition_tree.name: Items for the kit: A Hardened Moa Egg , which requires taking a normal Moa Egg and hardening it. Moa Eggs can be found in one of the Moa Nests south of Fort Ranik in Regent Valley Eggs can be hardened at Mourning Veil Falls , a landmark southwest of Durheim Archives , which can be reached after partial completion of the Kurzick storyline. Nesting Material , from Nuwisha in southern Resplendent Makuun for 5 Skree Wings . A Volcanic Rock , from north-eastern Perdition Rock . A Herring , from Gruhn the Fisher (in western Twin Serpent Lakes ), in exchange for 5 Bog Skale Fins (which can be farmed in Tears of the Fallen or Stingray Strand ). A Branch of Juni Berries , a reward from the Insatiable Appetite quest in Marga Coast . A Honeycomb , which is most easily obtained as a random drop from a Gift of the Traveler , Gift of the Huntsman , from PvE foes during Anniversary Celebrations , or completing A Hunter's Pride . (There are two other sources .)

To place the items in the incubator, double-click on the incubator to open a small window and drag the item into it. Doing this will remove the item from your inventory.  The incubator window will show translucent icons as place holders for the six items, which will be replaced with the opaque icon when each item is added.

Once all six items are placed in the incubator, travel to Sorrow's Furnace with the quest The Final Assault and The Forge Heart active. Fight your way to the central furnace and allow yourself to be hit by Sorrow's Flame , which will hatch the Black Moa Chick (consuming the incubator and its contents). If you are having trouble hatching the chick: check that you were actually hit by Sorrow's Flame and that all items are inside the incubator (and not just in your inventory).
Although the nearby giant furnace (near the Rage Binders ) uses a similar skill, the Black Moa Chick hatches only if you are covered by the liquid metal poured down by the Iron Forgeman.

Miniature_Black_Moa_Chick.description: The Black Moa Chick is a green miniature.

Minotaur_Horn.name: Minotaur Horn

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and expert salvage research is ongoing and can be found here .
Minotaurs can be found in the beginning of the mission. The Splinter Mines are effective to take out large groups of Minotaurs.

Leave Heroes' Audience and head to the northeast teleporter , along the most straightforward route there will be just 2 popups of Jade Scarabs and Rockshot Devourers . Use the teleporter to cross and follow the path to get all the Minotaur groups, including 2 bosses. The Minotaurs sometimes fight groups of Jade Scarabs, so do not wait too long before engaging these groups after spotting them or they may die before you get there. The farm is relatively safe and mostly consists of Minotaurs if you stick to the path, but you will encounter some popups of Jade Scarabs and Rockshot Devourers.
An average run yields approximately 5 Minotaur Horns. Additionally, the player marker on the map is the spot where Nicholas the Traveler will be if he is asking for Minotaur Horns.

Minotaur_Horn.description: Minotaur Horn is a trophy that drops from Minotaurs.

MOMD.name: Inscription

acquisition_tree.name: Inscriptions can be salvaged from any weapons that carry them by using a Perfect , expert , or superior salvage kit . (Expert and Superior kits have a chance of breaking the weapon when salvaging; see Salvage for details.) Weapons carrying inscription slots can be obtained in the following ways:
Nightfall and Eye of the North

children.name: Any drop of item rarity blue, purple or gold has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non- unique item that drops from the Urgoz 's elite chest or Kanaxai 's elite chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any weapon that drops from the Chest of Woe or Underworld Chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non-unique item that drops from the Hall of Heroes elite chest has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Some inscriptions cannot be unlocked at Priests of Balthazar unless your account includes Nightfall. (See specific notes in the tables below.)

MOMD.description: An inscription is a salvageable upgrade component that can be applied to equippable primary or off-hand weapons with an inscription slot.

There are many Leviathans within the southern and western portion of the map. Since the Outcasts are hostile to other inhabitants, let them kill foes of no interest, except of course for the Leviathans you need to engage in order to obtain their drops. From Bone Palace head into Joko's Domain and take out the groups in the sand immediately outside.  Head East off of the sand and take out the two groups on the granite to the north, then head directly south for more groups on the granite there. Desert Wurms will spawn with some groups.  This run hits 8 - 10 groups and can be completed in about 20 minutes. Margonites can be found along the way - pick up the bounty from the Ghostly Priest just outside of Bone Palace for some Lightbringer Points .

Abaddon's Mouth has a large amount of the necessary foes. Just doing the mission from start to finish will expose you to a large amount of encounters. A run can be done in 10-15 minutes with good heroes.

Enter Ice Floe from Thunderhead Keep and follow the marked path.  There are many patrols of Mursaat and Jade in the open area off the track.  Once you clear these, continue on for a few more groups along the path to Marhan's Grotto .

Mursaat_Token.description: The purpose and nature of the Mursaat Tokens are currently unknown; however, they drop not just from the Mursaat themselves, but also from the Jade constructs, which share the color, possibly material as well, as the tokens. All that is known about the tokens themselves apart from this is that, according to Nicholas the Traveler, they "have an untapped inner power, a power you can sense, waiting to detonate and ruin all life."

acquisition_tree.name: Inscriptions can be salvaged from any weapons that carry them by using a Perfect , expert , or superior salvage kit . (Expert and Superior kits have a chance of breaking the weapon when salvaging; see Salvage for details.) Weapons carrying inscription slots can be obtained in the following ways:
Nightfall and Eye of the North

children.name: Any drop of item rarity blue, purple or gold has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non- unique item that drops from the Urgoz 's elite chest or Kanaxai 's elite chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any weapon that drops from the Chest of Woe or Underworld Chest is guaranteed to carry an inscription slot and inscription.
Any equippable non-unique item that drops from the Hall of Heroes elite chest has a chance of carrying an inscription slot and inscription.
Some inscriptions cannot be unlocked at Priests of Balthazar unless your account includes Nightfall. (See specific notes in the tables below.)

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and expert salvage research is ongoing and can be found here .
Two different areas for farming in the Underworld

Phantom Residue is a common trophy item dropped by ghostly enemies that populate the Underworld. They can be more commonly found in the Chaos Planes and the Ice Wastes. Both areas can be accessed with relative ease with a full party and upon partial completion of the quest Clear the Chamber .

Upon entering the Underworld, it is recommended to slay the nearby groups of Bladed Aatxes , Grasping Darknesses and any wandering Skeleton of Dhuum before accepting quests. Return to the Lost Soul and accept the quest Clear the Chamber. This will cause additional groups of Grasping Darknesses to spawn. Eliminate them to gain access to the other areas of the Underworld. Further completion of the quest Clear the Chamber is not required for the purposes of farming Phantom Residue. You may proceed towards the Chaos Planes or Ice Wastes at this point.

Head southeast to reach the Chaos Planes, closely following the route provided as many paths branch off into different directions. Be wary of the many traps laid down by Obsidian Behemoths . Many of the enemies found here will drop Phantom Residue, but exert caution when slaying Banished Dream Riders , as they will spawn three waves of Mindblade Spectres .

Travel northeast and you will quickly find yourself in the Ice Wastes after a few groups of Bladed Aatxes. Enemies of interest for farming Phantom Residue are the Smite Crawlers . They will often be accompanied by wandering Coldfire Nights .

The quest A Good Deed. offers players unable or unwilling to enter the Underworld a meager opportunity to find Phantom Residues as it spawns a few dozen Smite Crawlers and Tortured Spirits . Be prepared to exit the zone when the dialogue with Sarah finishes so that you will not have to abandon the quest.

The nearby Chromatic Drakes can be used to fuel Sliver Armor to kill the various Wisps immediately outside of the Central Transfer Chamber . Alternatively, an earth prayer VoS dervish can solo kill the different wisps without much difficulty.

Using spell prevention and tanking skills, all of the Frozen Elementals and Whirling Wisps in the central area of level 1 can be killed by dragging them into the Ice Jet traps. Note that the tank will have to avoid/endure interrupts in the form of Lyssa's Assault .

Pillaged_Goods.name: Pillaged Goods

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Starting from Jennur's Horde , head north through the Vehjin Mines to the Holdings of Chokhin portal . Once through, head north to kill the 14 giants. Using a Spoil Victor 55hp build (and focusing solely on the giants), the run takes 10 minutes including rezoning at the Vehjin Mines portal. A Vow of Silence build with Shroud of Distress using apple, cupcake, and pie can do a run in 7 minutes.

Start from either Basalt Grotto or Jennur's Horde. Head towards the blue circles on the farming map, which mark the locations of groups of giants that each spawn together with 2-4 Hunting Minotaurs . Pull groups apart when attacking. Bring knock down prevention to counter Giant Stomp if using spirits or you are not solo farming. Avoid the Skree group (at the position marker on the map); they can be hard to solo (although you should be able to outrun them).

Pillaged_Goods.description: Pillaged Goods are infrequent salvage item drops from Bull Trainer Giants.

Plague_Idol.name: Plague Idol

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .
Start from the The Marketplace or Nahpui Quarter , and farm the Am Fah along the eastern corridor. Click here to see the short path or here to see the extended path.
The quest Deactivating P.O.X. spawns a number of Am Fah foes as well as Jade Brotherhood allies, making it a good place to farm.

Plague_Idol.description: The times are hard and fear conquers the hearts of mankind. With the plague on the loose, Imperial Guards are outnumbered more and more every day. The Am Fah, a street gang plotting against the imperialists and responsible for several murders and robberies, sees the plague, which turned the city into a place of terror, as a blessing. The Am Fah worship this plague, using these idols as the symbols of their worship, and are even willing to infect themselves to spread the plague's influence further.

Roaring_Ether_Claw.name: Roaring Ether Claw

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and expert salvage research is ongoing and can be found here .
Farming route in The Mirror of Lyss

Enter from Dzagonur Bastion or Honur Hill . There is an Elemental Hunt bounty available outside Dzagonur Bastion. If your character does not need Lightbringer points but you want blessings , you can determine which outpost you enter from based on the blessings offered by the avatar outside of the outpost (i.e. Champion of Balthazar and Lyssa's Muse outside Dzagonur Bastion and Honur Hill, respectively). There are nine groups of four elementals each in the eastern part of the zone. Most of these groups contain three Roaring Ethers, but some contain only two. Only the level 24 Roaring Ethers have Resurrection Signet and there are usually one or two of these to a group. They will not use Resurrection Signet on the Ruby Djinn or Sapphire Djinn in their group. Prioritizing Ruby or Sapphire Djinn, and then Roaring Ethers with unspent Resurrection Signets will make the fights easier.  If farming for Nicholas the Traveler, he collects Sapphire Djinn Essences in the tenth week after collecting Roaring Ether Claws, so consider keeping any Sapphire Djinn Essences that drop.

Roaring_Ether_Claw.description: Roaring Ether Claws are items dropped by Roaring Ethers in parts of Vabbi. They are used to make charm bracelets.

Starting from Tarnished Haven , travel through Alcazia Tangle to the portal to Arbor Bay. Most Simian and Quetzal groups can be maneuvered around without combat. Running skills or summoning a decoy spirit can help bypass the rest.

Once in Arbor Bay, stay out of the water and kill Savage Oakhearts and Fanged Ayahuasca. Consider bringing hex removal skills, as Fanged Ayahuasca use many health degeneration hexes. Rezone at the portal to Alcazia Tangle to reset the area. acquisition_tree.name: Enter either from Tears of the Fallen or The Black Curtain and travel towards the other exit. Stay in the green grassy areas and range left and right to trigger all the Fog Nightmare pop-ups. When you reach the opposite exit, zone out and back to reset spawns. Stay away from the sandy areas which are full of Bog Scales but few/no Fog Nightmares. There are Ancient Oakhearts along the way and some large mobs of Forest Minotaurs in the south to deal with too. If your inventory gets full, Artisan Sivan can buy your items.

Leaving from the Temple of the Ages , head south and then southeast. Kill all the pop-ups that you find, looping around to the north. Either rezone using the portal or start again from the outpost. An example build can be found at PvX .

Start from Beacon's Perch , you can head into any direction as the entire explorable area is populated by Shiverpeak centaurs , except the corridor that leads to Griffon's Mouth . Shiverpeak Longbows use Winter and Shiverpeak centaurs have additional armor rating against cold damage , so avoid using elemental damage , since your party will constantly be within range of a Spirit of Winter (i.e. destroying a Spirit of Winter will cause another Shiverpeak Longbow, possibly in another centaur mob within spirit range of the mob you are attacking, to create another Spirit of Winter). If using a spirit spammer build, consider using Gaze of Fury on a Spirit of Winter. Shiverpeak Warriors can block . Avoid using conditions , since Shiverpeak Protectors can remove them, which in the process also heals.

Storm Kin can be found near the exit to the Salt Flats . To get there quickly, start in Augury Rock , follow the path westwards and turn north as soon as possible. There's a teleporter there, but it's easier to go west into the basin as some of the Storm Kin dwell there anyway. Exit north of the Resurrection Shrine to Salt Flats and turn around and come back to Prophet's Path to refresh Storm Kin. 4-5 Shriveled Eyes are farmable each time you enter.
The first group of Storm Kin is right outside of Seeker's Passage . Storm Kin patrol the area eastwards and northwards from the first group. Another group is just south of the artisan Sennat Sen .

Starting from Zen Daijun , follow the route up to the Crimson Skull camp near the sea, you can evade all foes except for some Crimson Skull on the route. At the camp, four high level Crimson Skull reside (at the location of the player marker on the map) together with Miki the Skull Spirit who has a chance of dropping 1 or 2 Silver Crimson Skull Coins. More medium level Crimson Skull dropping Silver Coins are around the camp and on the route towards it. This run will also return some Gold Crimson Skull Coins and Copper Crimson Skull Coins . Having The Captured Son active will vastly improve spawns of all levels of Crimson Skulls though it makes farming a bit more difficult. Without the quest active, runs yield an average of 2 Silver Crimson Skull Coins.

Start from Tsumei Village , following the route on the map, you will encounter no foes other than Crimson Skull. There are three bosses on the route with a chance of dropping two Silver Crimson Skull Coins at once (marked on the map), four high level Crimson Skull with a chance of dropping Gold Crimson Skull Coins (also marked on the map) and a lot of low level mobs dropping Copper Crimson Skull Coins, including some pop-ups. Average drops are around 6 Copper, 2 Silver and 0.5 Gold coins per run (resulting in one gold coin for every two runs).

All Skelk in Tarnished Coast attack at melee range , so skills that deal area of effect or point blank area of effect damage are effective against them.
Farming Skelk Claws in Verdant Cascades
Start from Umbral Grotto and go east-southeast. Once you get past the northern big mountain, venture north but do not cross the river. Instead, work your way back closing a circle.

Most Skelk groups contain three to four foes, with those outside the suggested route having up to six foes and therefore not suggested for solo farming. Additional Skelk groups can be found to the southwest, but are attacked by neighbouring Quetzal as soon as the player enters compass range.
Each run usually yields 2-7 Skelk Claws.

This farming will remain useful as long as you do not accept the rewards, abandon it once completed and re-take instead as many times as needed. Secondary quests will not halt player's storyline progress.

Single players will face some challenge since Harpy groups have Distracting Shot , Healer's Boon , Renew Life and "We Shall Return!" while facing disadvantage from highground archers when there is limited free areas to run away. Rocks and hills can be used to hide from arrows. Solo players can hunt groups without Griffins (their monks). Click here to see paths.

There is no need to take 8 party members as long as the group can widstand a single group, but watch over-aggro. There is a Do Not Touch at the south, near Commander Sadi-Belai 's group. Click here to see the path.

Enter The Eternal Grove (explorable area) from Vasburg Armory

Non-boss groups with Stone Scale Kirin, Dragon Moss and Undergrowth seem to have about a 50% chance of having a gaki. Go immediately to the left (southeast) and kill the group there. Then move west to the center of the large open area in front of the Armory, clear several groups there, then move east to kill The Scar Eater. Look down below to the group south of the bridge; if there is no gaki there, leave it be. Move west through a group of Wardens, go over a small bridge and kill The Time Eater. Map travel back to the Armory because trying to find more Gaki elsewhere in the zone is not time-efficient.
Note: salvage Stone Horns (and other items that yield Granite Slabs ), as they are usually in high demand; making this is a nice money-making farm.

Spider_Leg.name: Spider Leg

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Leave Fort Ranik and head South toward the Basket of Apples . Kill any spiders you encounter. Picking up the basket (once) will cause more spiders to spawn. Drop the basket (since it's not needed) and head back towards the split on the map to continue South-West. Once you spot a circle of Aloes, turn West and cross the stream to a shallow gorge with 10 more spiders. There are even more spiders at the end of the passage, around a circle of hunters. acquisition_tree.name: Farming Spiked Crests in Sanctum Cay

Farm the Lightning Drakes on the beach in the early area of this mission. The Lightning Drakes spawn at the player marker on the screenshot. You will first have to pass by between 2-3 groups of 2-3 Inferno Imps before reaching the location.  There are between 2-3 groups of 2-3 drakes which can easily be killed solo . Since they do not inflict a great deal of damage, a single self-heal should be sufficient. Typically, you will find 0-1 crest per run.

Stone Carvings drop in the Echovald Forest in these areas:

Arborstone (explorable area) - heading left as you enter, 3 of the 4 bosses can be found relatively close to each other and have no other foes nearby. See the Notes section for how to spawn additional stone guardians. Arborstone Mission Morostav Trail - travel west along the south wall from Durheim Archives to find 3 groups of stone pillars that will collapse to reveal Stone elementals once you are within their area. This run takes 5 - 15 mins, depending on strategy, and encounters 12 Stone elementals. Killing all enemies along the route, including the boss and his group found directly next to the last group of Stone elementals nets 900 - 1000 faction per run.

Stormy_Eye.name: Stormy Eye

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

Start from Serenity Temple . The area all around the Pockmark crystal has several groups of 2-3 Storm Riders , some of them patrol the area counter-clockwise. The boss Larrk Etherburn sometimes spawns south of the crystal. Storm Riders won't use Backfire if you wield a martial weapon, and will also only use Energy Tap to get energy (therefore not use it at all when wielding a martial weapon). Any armor-respecting damage is doubled against Storm Riders since they have 20 armor rating against all damage types. Other foes on the map (mainly Devourer popups and groups of Stone Elementals ) deal negligible damage to targets with maximum armor rating. A speed boost is advised. One run is usually enough to get at least 5 Stormy Eyes.

The lower part of the route on the map leads to the location of Nicholas the Traveler when it is the correct week for him to spawn in the area. It is possible to go straight to him by heading south when leaving Serenity Temple : this way you'll also encounter Storm Riders groups in the area with a big crystal. Though a bit less than the aforementionned route around the Pockmark crystal, following this route is usually enough to gather 3 stormy eyes.

Stormy_Eye.description: Stormy Eyes are trophy items dropped from Storm Riders in Ascalon.

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

There are many Devourers in Ettin's Back. For the most part they are spread out and patrols of Thorn Stalkers or Centaurs overlap many of their spawn locations. The largest concentration being in the area east of Ventari's Refuge near where it says Ettin's Back on the main map.
The westernmost arid section of Majesty's Rest, just inside the portal from Sage Lands , contains an abundance of Devourers.
The arid central section of Sage Lands surrounding Druid's Overlook contains an abundance of Devourers. This is perhaps the most efficient farming location.

acquisition_tree.name: Inscriptions can be salvaged from any weapons that carry them by using a Perfect , expert , or superior salvage kit . Truffle.name: Truffle

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and expert salvage research is ongoing and can be found here .

Enter from Brauer Academy . The southeastern quadrant of the area contains eight rapidly- patrolling groups, each consisting of one Dredge Gatherer and one Fungal Wallow, in addition to the boss Rot Foulbelly , who patrols with Nundak the Archer and two Dredge Guardians . The larger, stationary groups of Dredge can all be avoided except for the very first group you meet when following the route. Because the groups move fast and occasionally intersect with the larger stationary groups of Dredge and have various paths, it is advised not to simply chase them. Instead, walk around the later part of the route on the map above (in green). All patrols will at some point in their route cross this area. Use the higher ground from the hills here and a Longbow to easily pull them towards you. Do not fight the patrols too close to the stationary groups as these contain a Dredge Gardener , which will try to heal targets from the patrol and pull the entire group into the fight.

Bringing condition removal might be necessary as you will be affected by a lot of cripple from traps, poison and the incidental blind from the Dredge. The boss group is way harder to kill than the other patrols and only has 1 possible Truffle drop. Avoiding the group if you find it hard to kill is possible.
The run yields on average 3 Truffles.

Truffle.description: Truffles are a rare delicacy that's highly prized by chefs and collectors alike.

Unnatural_Seed.name: Unnatural Seed

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found here .

The long plain west of Barradin Estate (see picture on the right) has roughly 30 Aloe Seeds and Aloe Husks spread across it. Almost all foes are non-hostile and the area also features numerous bandits and elementals in the northern cave, making it also good to reduce loot scaling and farm Enchanted Lodestones and/or Worn Belts . Focusing on the seeds only, one run is expected to take around 7 minutes.

Alternatively, the quest The Vineyard Problem spawns a group of 9 plants to the east of the outpost, which can be killed in under 1 minute per run as long as the quest isn't completed. Although this run is undermined by loot scaling, doing a small detour to the west (see path 2 on the second picture) allows to kill a few additional 3-5 seeds and some elementals while increasing the run duration to a bit above 2 minutes. However, this run requires the player to be warrior primary or secondary and abandon and retake the quest (as well as discarding the Starter Axe Little Thom hands out) every time. This process is easier with a secondary account.

If seeking to also farm experience , the Northlands have a decent number of level 5 Oakhearts throughout their western side. If you do not care about the survivor title, you can rezone faster by letting a group of Charr kill you in order to be resurrected at the entrance shrine. Rezoning is easier with a secondary account.

acquisition_tree.name: Drop and expert salvage research is ongoing and can be found here .
Warning: This key section of the article is incomplete. You can help the Guild Wars Wiki by expanding it .
Farming route for water djinn essence in Turai's Procession

Start from The Gate of Desolation. Head south through Turai's Procession. Proceed through the winding path. Lots of water Djinn in the area. Due to the large amount of enemies in between the entrance and the farming location it may be best to use a Hero team to reach the spot before flagging them away upon reaching the farming spot.
This is the quickest method for a total of eleven level 15 water djinn and nothing else close to an outpost. However, it requires a considerable setup:
A party member with the quest War Preparations (Wind and Water) active, which one of the last Elonian-only primary quests .
A fitting build that can defeat the waves of Djinn.

This means that without a partner to enter the area with, doing it with the Elonian character requires a sufficient level and skills suited for farming. Alernatively, a high level hero can be used for help. (For example, doing the quest Hole of Istan can unlock several level 20 heroes, including Vekk to gain access to elemental damage-based builds to quickly kill the djinn.)

After the character with the quest has spoken to Captain Bolduhr , enter Methani Keys and approach the five sailors , avoiding the popup Mandragor that will appear when straying slightly north from the quest's path, as well as the Skale to the south hat will patrol near the target location.
Once the sailors are approached, three level 15 Water Djinn will spawn, followed by a second wave of three and a third wave of five. The sailors do not have to survive for all djinn to spawn. Do not speak to Kinya Kela , but rezone to reset the quest for another run.

Water_Djinn_Essence.description: Water Djinn Essences are the essences of water-based Djinn. They can attract underground water from a wide distance. It is also used in recipes.

The quest Bandit Raid can be used to farm bandits right outside of Ashford Abbey. However, loot scaling reduces the interest of this farm.
Leave Fort Ranik and go west. After the skales, follow the main road; the area between the exit to Lakeside County and the bridge leading to the statue of Melandru is heavy populated with bandits.
The northern woods are populated with bandits.

The western area has a lot of bandits. This run is more interesting than the others due to the possibility to also farm Unnatural Seeds (Aloe Seeds and Husks are all over the place and will go down in one hit).

Worn_Belt.description: Worn Belts are dropped by Bandits in pre-Searing Ascalon.

acquisition_tree.name: As with all of Zehtuka's items, Zehtuka's Great Horn is dropped only as the party approaches its spawning point in The Desolation :

Zho's_Journal.name: Zho's Journal

acquisition_tree.name: Zho's Journal can be acquired after defeating Zho in the Norn Fighting Tournament .

children.name: Zho only appears as an opponent during round 3 of the Norn Fighting Tournament; if she does not spawn, restart and try again.
Characters that do not have a copy in their inventory can get another by speaking with Zho in Gunnar's Hold , where she hangs out with the other henchmen .
If you do not have room in your inventory when you defeat Zho, you will not receive a journal and you cannot request one from her in Gunnar's Hold.

Zho's_Journal.description: Zho's Journal contains a log of Zho's encounter and subsequent life with a Black Moa. This item is used for the cross-campaign scavenger hunt for the Black Moa Chick.
